lines.beaver: 민수야, 요즘 진로 때문에 고민이 많아.
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, I've been worrying a lot about my career lately.
lines.beaver_roman: Minsuya, yojeum jillo ttaemune gomini mana.
lines.en: It's hard to find work that fits your aptitude, right?

lines.beaver: 응. 사무직이 좋을지 전문직이 좋을지 모르겠어.
lines.beaver_en: Yeah. I can't decide between an office job and a professional one.
lines.beaver_roman: eung. samujigi joeulji jeonmunjigi joeulji moreugesseo.
lines.learner: 사무직은 입사가 쉽지만 전문직은 자격증이 필요해.
lines.en: Office jobs are easier to get into, but professional jobs need a license.
lines.roman: samujigeun ipsaga swipjiman jeonmunjigeun jagyeokjeungi piryohae.

lines.beaver: 디자이너는 어때? 너 그림 잘 그리잖아.
lines.beaver_en: What about being a designer? You draw well.
lines.beaver_roman: dijaineoneun eottae? neo geurim jal geurijana.
lines.en: For me, design is a hobby rather than a job.

lines.beaver_en: Then what about business? Your uncle is an entrepreneur.
lines.learner: 기업가는 경력보다 용기가 더 필요한 것 같아.
lines.en: I think entrepreneurs need courage more than experience.
lines.roman: gieopganeun gyeongnyeokboda yonggiga deo piryohan geot gata.

lines.beaver: 요즘 실업 문제도 심해서 더 무서워.
lines.beaver_en: Unemployment is bad these days, so it's even scarier.
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum sireom munjedo simhaeseo deo museowo.
lines.learner: 우리 부모님은 농사를 지으셔. 그것도 전문 직업이야.
lines.en: My parents farm. That's a professional job too.
lines.roman: uri bumonimeun nongsareul jieusyeo. geugeotdo jeonmun jigeobiya.

lines.beaver: 농사도 기술이 필요하겠다. 다른 예도 있어?
lines.beaver_en: Farming must take skill too. Any other examples?
lines.beaver_roman: nongsado gisuri piryohagetda. dareun yedo isseo?
lines.learner: 우리 이모는 가정주부였다가 다시 회사원이 됐어.
lines.en: My aunt was a housewife, then became an office worker again.
lines.roman: uri imoneun gajeongjubuyeotdaga dasi hoesawoni dwaesseo.

lines.beaver: 와, 경력이 끊겨도 입사할 수 있구나.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, you can join a company even after a career break.
lines.beaver_roman: wa, gyeongnyeogi kkeunkyeodo ipsahal su itguna.
lines.learner: 응. 요즘은 원서를 낼 때 적성 검사도 봐.
lines.en: Yeah. These days they also do aptitude tests when you apply.
lines.roman: eung. yojeumeun wonseoreul nael ttae jeokseong geomsado bwa.

lines.beaver: 나는 무슨 일이 맞을지 한눈에 알고 싶어.
lines.beaver_en: I wish I could see at a glance what job suits me.
lines.beaver_roman: naneun museun iri majeulji hannune algo sipeo.
lines.learner: 운전기사나 요리사 같은 기술직도 생각해 봐.
lines.en: Think about skilled jobs too, like driver or cook.
lines.roman: unjeongisana yorisa gateun gisuljikdo saenggakae bwa.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of work do you want to do?
lines.learner: 음, 나는 과학자보다는 교사가 되고 싶어.
lines.en: Well, I'd rather be a teacher than a scientist.
lines.roman: eum, naneun gwahakjabodaneun gyosaga doego sipeo.

lines.beaver_en: That's great. I'll start preparing, beginning with a license.
lines.learner: 그래, 같이 힘내자! 다음에 또 얘기하자.
lines.en: Okay, let's both do our best! Let's talk again later.
lines.roman: geurae, gachi himnaeja! daeume tto yaegihaja.
